title: Complexity Router
description: Tune how incoming requests are classified into four tiers. Thresholds and keyword lists feed the <1>complexity_tier</1> field that routing rules can target.
noConfig: No complexity router configuration is available.

simpleMedium.label: Simple → Medium
simpleMedium.description: Scores at or below this are classified as SIMPLE.

mediumComplex.label: Medium → Complex
mediumComplex.description: Scores above simple_medium and at or below this are MEDIUM.

complexReasoning.label: Complex → Reasoning
complexReasoning.description: Scores above this are REASONING. Everything in between is COMPLEX.

errors.greaterThanSimpleMedium: Must be greater than Simple → Medium
errors.greaterThanMediumComplex: Must be greater than Medium → Complex

keywords.title: Keyword Lists
keywords.hint: Lowercased and deduplicated on save. Each list requires at least one entry.
keywords.placeholder: Type a keyword and press Enter

simple.label: Simple keywords
simple.description: Phrases that bias the request toward the SIMPLE tier (greetings, trivia, small talk).

code.label: Code keywords
code.description: Signals that the request involves code, debugging, or programming artifacts.

technical.label: Technical keywords
technical.description: Architecture, infrastructure, and operational terms that raise the complexity score.

reasoning.label: Reasoning keywords
reasoning.description: Strong reasoning triggers. Matching these phrases can override tier selection toward the REASONING tier.

restoreDialog.title: Restore defaults
restoreDialog.description: This will reset all tier boundaries and keyword lists to the factory defaults. Your current configuration will be lost. This action cannot be undone.
